items.title: AI Search Tools Easily Fooled by Fake Content
items.description: New research shows AI crawlers like Perplexity, Atlas, and ChatGPT are surprisingly easy to fool.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-27596: Progress Software
items.description: A CVSS score 6.4 AV:A/AC:H/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Alex Williams from Converge Technology Solutions' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-10-29, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-02-26 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
